Measures
The Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (ECR) is a shortened version of the Attachment-Related Anxiety subscale, with only nine items that tracked most strongly to the anxiety subscale (Sible et al., 2005). A Cronbach’s α = 0.94 was calculated. To measure social anxiety, the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (SIAS) was used. The analysis showed a Cronbach’s α = 0.9. Finally, the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (RSE) was used to capture a measure of participant self esteem (Cronbach’s α = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
The “psych” package in R was used to score participant responses. A key was created for each psychological measure using the “scoreItems()” function. Reverse scoring was used for items items 5, 9, and 11 in the SIAS and items 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 in the RES.
